payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all divisors of string length to find minimal period, then verify second string matches, count divisors of GCD of repeat counts.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a brute-force search over divisor candidates to determine the minimal period, which is a complete search with pruning (by taking minimum). No sliding window or amortized technique is used. Among complete_search subtypes, search_branch_and_bound is the closest match despite lacking traditional lower-bound pruning.
